title: Beware the Mallworld Target
content: Had another dream about the Mallworld Target. Out of all the Mallworld dreams, the Target ones fills me with the most dread. It's always night when I visit, I'm always by myself, the lights are always dimmed in the store, some calamity is always happening - either it's flooding or an earthquake causes the merchandise to come crashing off the shelves, and last night? I found myself in the backrooms. It was full of flies. There's just something wrong about that part of Mallworld. Be careful if you find yourself there.
